newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad holds talks with Lebanon's Hariri.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad holds talks with Lebanon's Hariri.

text.p: President Hafez al-Assad and Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri on Monday discussed French ideas to revive Arab-Israeli peace talks.
Syrian presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said the meeting was held in the presidential palace in the Syrian capital.
Hariri, who flew from Paris on Sunday, also briefed Vice President Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara on two meetings with French President Jacques Chirac.
The French president phoned Assad after his first meeting with Hariri in Paris on February 11 and said later that peace talks between Syria, Lebanon and Israel should resume.
Syria and Lebanon want a European role, especially French participation, in the U.S.-brokered Arab-Israeli peace negotiations.

Sporadic Syrian-Israeli peace talks are deadlocked over the Golan Heights, captured by Israel from Syria in 1967. Syria which wants a full Israeli withdrawal but Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects the concept of returning occupied Arab lands for peace.
